with.script:
printf '[controls] Ready. Select Cancel run, then Confirm cancel to stop this run.
'

i=1
while [ "$i" -le 30 ]; do
  printf '[controls] Working: tick %s/30\n' "$i"
  sleep 1
  i=$((i + 1))
done

printf '[controls] Completed normally. Run again creates a separate run using this same definition.
'
